title: Four hours of missing time and Crohn's disease healed

tellings.quote: 4 hours later, I come walking back to the river where they were and my son was missing.

plain: A North Carolina man named Chris Bledsoe says that in 2007, near a river at Riverbank, North Carolina, he lost four hours he cannot account for, and came walking back to the river to find his son missing. Bledsoe tells this as his own experience and links it to the healing of his Crohn's disease, a long-term illness of the gut. If true, the encounter would have changed his body as well as his life.
